Name: Better Blue Grass
Author: HomesteadyEddy
Description:
[b]Better Blue Grass
[/b]Blue grass in vanilla Stardew Valley has three problems:
it spreads slowly, it can't overtake regular grass, and you have to wait until late game to access it. This mod fixes all three. [b]What It Does
Configurable Spread Speed - [/b]Control how fast blue grass spreads. The default setting makes it spread at the same speed as vanilla, so adjust as you please, however, it will still be allowed to replace green grass.
[b]Spreads Through Green Grass - [/b]Blue grass now replaces regular grass as it spreads instead of being blocked by it. Plant a starter and let it naturally take over your pastures without having to scythe everything first.
[b]Optional Early Access Recipes - [/b]Toggle simplified crafting recipes if you want to use blue grass earlier in the game. The vanilla recipes remain available if you prefer the original progression.
[b]Configuration -[/b] features can be adjusted or disabled through the config file. Works with Generic Mod Config Menu for in-game configuration.
[b]Compatibility[/b] [b]-[/b] Should work with most grass and animal mods. Uses Harmony patches for grass spreading behavior.
